reason: User requests finish only the single in-flight HumanEval/35 response, then start no further questions, conditions, models or downloads; outage moved earlier
policy: Save and grade only the in-flight response; deny all later work. After terminal records, owned server cleanup and original process exits, shut down as the user requested. The earlier 06:00 reservation is removed. No automatic benchmark resume.
stop_boundary: Finish the single already in-flight response, save and grade it, then admit no further question/condition/model/download
compatibility: finish_by set to hold time so already loaded admission modules also reject every subsequent boundary; this does not abort an in-flight HTTP request
os_shutdown_mode: After HumanEval/35 response (or recorded request failure), evidence saving/grading and all owned benchmark/server processes exit
